_comment: The migration PLAN, per Okta app: who owns it, which wave, and the two switches the Okta root reads (lab/terraform/okta clinic-apps.tf locals). Decisions live here; FACTS (protocol, users, groups, policies, Entra objects, sign-ins, status) are read from the Okta API and Microsoft Graph by inventory.mjs - never typed here. A cut-over is a PR that sets cutover = true; a rollback is the PR (or local apply) that sets it back. Owners are scenario roles, not real people.

Clinic Lab Results.owner: Clinic lab manager (business) / Clinic IT lead (technical)

Clinic Billing.blocker: no billing service provider exists in the lab; its users arrive with an HR department (runbook Phase 3)

Clinic Scheduling (legacy).blocker: bookmark app: the vendor offers no SSO yet - becomes an Entra linked sign-on tile
